# Offline invoice fonts

These unmodified fonts come from the Google Fonts repository. Each family's
SIL Open Font License is included alongside its files. `sources.json` records
the pinned upstream URLs and SHA-256 hashes for the downloaded files.

English: IBM Plex Sans. Arabic: IBM Plex Sans Arabic.

Both families support Regular, Medium and Bold. IBM Plex Sans Arabic includes
separate files for all three weights; English uses one variable font.

Assets are embedded with the app; no installation or internet connection is
needed. Previous font identifiers remain readable in saved designs and backups;
all invoice text now renders with the IBM Plex Sans families.
